data.name: Intro1
data.value: Manage human resources in manufacturing plants and ensure effective assignment and arrangement of production line workers.

data.name: Intro2
data.value: This system typically includes the following functions:

data.name: Feature1
data.value: 1. Personnel Data Management: Record employee basic information, skills, and experience.

data.name: Feature2
data.value: 2. Production Scheduling: Assign employees to appropriate workstations based on production plans and line requirements, ensuring adequate human resources at each station.

data.name: Feature3
data.value: 3. Work Progress Tracking: Track employee work progress and product flow on the production line, and adjust assignments in real-time to address any production line issues.

data.name: Feature4
data.value: 4. Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze employee performance and production line efficiency, providing reports and data to help management make better decisions.

data.name: Feature5
data.value: 5. Safety and Monitoring: Monitor the working environment and employee safety on the production line to ensure all operations comply with safety standards.

data.name: Benefit
data.value: Using an online production line work assignment system can improve production line efficiency and product quality while reducing errors and work delays in the production process.

data.name: SOPIntro
data.value: Standard operating procedure documents compiled and managed on digital platforms. These procedure documents describe in detail how to execute tasks to ensure consistency and efficiency.

data.name: SOPBenefit1
data.value: Unified Standards: Ensure all employees follow the same operating standards, reducing errors and rework.

data.name: SOPBenefit2
data.value: Simplified Training: New employees can learn through online SOPs, speeding up their onboarding process.

data.name: SOPBenefit3
data.value: Consistency: Ensure consistency in operational processes, improving work quality and result consistency.

data.name: SOPBenefit4
data.value: Continuous Improvement: Continuously improve business processes and operating standards through real-time updates and feedback mechanisms.

data.name: SOPBenefit5
data.value: Reduce Paper and Printing Costs: Digital documents reduce the need for physical storage and printing.

data.name: SOPBenefit6
data.value: Save Time: Improve work efficiency and reduce time wasted due to unclear processes or errors.

data.name: SOPBenefit7
data.value: Real-time Updates and Audits: Ensure SOPs are consistent with the latest laws and company policies, reducing compliance risks.

data.name: SOPBenefit8
data.value: Clear Operating Procedures: All employees can easily access operating procedures to understand company processes and requirements.
